description: This file defines classes and data structures related to Service Prioritization Rules within the wfa_map namespace, including class definitions, bit fields, and related parameters for a TLV (Type-Length-Value) protocol used in network configurations.

classes.name: tlvServicePrioritizationRule
classes.description: A TLV class representing service prioritization rules, including its type identifier and rule parameters.

classes.name: sServicePrioritizationRule
classes.description: A structure defining a service prioritization rule with fields for ID, precedence, output, and bit field components.

classes.name: sServicePrioritizationRuleBitsField1
classes.description: A bit field structure containing a 'add_remove' flag and reserved bits standard for rule modification.

classes.name: sServicePrioritizationRuleBitsField2
classes.description: A bit field structure with an 'always_match' flag and reserved bits, used to specify rule matching behavior.
